WendyGfxProp.name: Lemmy and Wendy OAM tables and drawing
summary: Data: tile properties (YXPPCCCT), OAM size bits (per tile, 6 tiles per frame) and tile counts (per frame, 23 frames) for Lemmy and Wendy, then the draw routine.
Draw routine (called from the Lemmy/Wendy pipe code at $03CC14 with the sprite index in X): puts the frame [$1602]'s tiles into OAM.
Sprite state 6 (Wendy) uses the Wendy tables (DATA_03CF7C, DATA_03D090, DATA_03D1A4, WendyGfxProp, DATA_03D3CC); other states use the Lemmy tables.
Quirk: OAM size values of 4 appear in the size tables; probably unintended leftovers (the size bits are 0 or 2).
Parameters: X: sprite index. Returns: X preserved; OAM slots from the draw info index filled.

s03D524.name: Table: Peach message letter sprites
summary: 4 bytes per letter: X, Y, tile, OAM properties ($0E). 84 letters in 4 lines (Y = $20, $30, $40, $50). Rows below are offset by 2: each row starts at the tile of a letter.

s03D674.name: Draw Peach message letters
summary: Draws the letters of Princess Peach's message revealed so far: [$1921] letters from the table at DATA_03D524 as 8x8 sprites, written to OAM from $0200 up.
The letter count is advanced by the Peach sprite code (CODE_03AEAF) with timers from DATA_03AE5B.
Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved).

s03D700.name: Table: bridge segment X positions
summary: X pixel position of each of the 12 bridge segments broken by BreakBridge: $B0 down to $00 in steps of $10.

s03D70C.name: Reznor bridge: wait for two dead Reznors
summary: Called from the Reznor sprite code ($03989F) every frame for the sprite in slot 7. Sums the four Reznor-dead flags ([$1520]-[$1523]); with fewer than 2 dead it returns, otherwise it falls into BreakBridge.

BreakBridge.name: Break bridge one segment at a time
summary: Once 2 Reznors are dead, destroys the bridge from the outside in, a segment pair (left and mirrored right) every $40 frames: spawns smoke puffs and plays sound $07 at the start,
then $04 frames later replaces both blocks with Map16 tile $25 and queues a stripe image that blanks 3 BG tiles on the two rows of each block.
[$1B9F] = number of segments broken (0-12); [$14A7] = segment timer, [$98]/[$9A] = block position scratch.
Sub-entries: $03D759 mirrors the block X ($0170 - X), $03D766 smoke puffs, $03D77F erases one block and queues the tilemap update.

IggyPlatform.name: Mode 7 room: clear map, draw Iggy platform
summary: Data: IggyPlatform = 16x16 block numbers of the tilting platform ($00 = empty); DATA_03D8EC = 4 tile numbers per block (2x2 tiles, column order).
Code ($03D958, called from game mode code at $0097D8): clears the whole Mode 7 tilemap to tile $FF, then, for Iggy/Larry rooms only ([$0D9B] bit 6 clear),
draws the platform at tilemap row 16, column 16 and keeps a copy of the block layout at $0AF6-$0BF5.
Quirk: the second tile row of each block row is written by repeating the same blocks with [$03] = 1.

s03D9DE.name: Table: Mode 7 picture tile maps
summary: Tile number maps for the Mode 7 boss pictures, copied to the buffer $7E:C680 by CODE_03DEDF.
Frames $00-$1D are 4x4 tiles (16 bytes). Tile numbers come in pairs: even = normal, odd (= even | 1) = horizontally mirrored.
From +$1E0 the pictures are 8 tiles wide; the last 4 rows are selected by frame number, the other rows of the 12-row picture come from fixed positions +$320-$38F.

KoopaPalPtrLo.name: Pointer table: boss palettes, low bytes
summary: Low bytes of the bank 0 addresses of the 12-byte palettes for boss numbers 0-4.

KoopaPalPtrHi.name: Mode 7 boss graphics and palette setup
summary: High bytes of the palette pointers, ExGFX file numbers per boss (DATA_03DD78), then the setup routine ($03DD7D, called from Reznor and Koopa kid init code):
stores the boss number in [$13FC], copies the boss palette (6 colors) to $0707, decompresses the ExGFX file and converts its 128 3bpp tiles to Mode 7 8bpp tile pairs (normal + mirrored) in VRAM,
and blanks the 96-byte tilemap buffer at $7E:C680. Boss 4 also draws an 8x8 tile block and sets Mode 7 values [$2C], [$38], [$39].
Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved). Sub-routine $03DDE5 converts one tile with the help of $03DE39/$03DE3C.

s03DE4E.name: Table: 8x8 Mode 7 tile block
summary: Tile numbers (8 rows of 8) drawn by CODE_03DE8E; the last entry $3F is probably the corner.

s03DE8E.name: Draw 8x8 tile block into Mode 7 map
summary: Writes the 64 tile numbers of DATA_03DE4E as 8 rows of 8 tiles into the Mode 7 tilemap at VRAM word address $0A9C (row 21, column 28), one row per $80 words.
Only used for boss 4 by the setup routine.

s03DEBB.name: Tables: Mode 7 scroll offsets and animation
summary: DATA_03DEBB: scroll offsets ($0100, $0110). DATA_03DEBF/03DEC7/03DECF: animated top strip tiles. DATA_03DED7: source offsets of animated rows.

s03DEDF.name: Position Mode 7 picture, build tilemap
summary: Called each frame by the boss and Reznor code. Sets the Mode 7 scroll [$3A]/[$3C] so the picture sits at the sprite position in X/Y,
then builds the tilemap in the buffer at $7E:C680: either a 4x4 picture frame ([$0D9B] bit 0 clear) or a 12-row, 8-wide picture with animated rows ([$0D9B] bit 0 set).
[$1BA2]: bits 0-6 = frame number, bit 7 = flip horizontally (reads rows backwards and swaps tile numbers with their mirror, bit 0).
[$1BA1]: only its sign (bit 15 of the word) is used. $03DFAE: computes one scroll value (Y = 0: horizontal, Y = 2: vertical).
Parameters: X: sprite index (preserved). A is lost.

s03DFC4.name: Table: palette set offsets
summary: 8 offsets in steps of $0E into DATA_00B69E, indexed by [$1429] at $03E039; probably lightning flash palette sets.
